# Navigation/Step

A step descriptor with content and completion state. Try its completion action before moving forward.

## Identity

- Class: `StepComponent`
- Selector: `dl-step`
- Kind: standalone component
- [Component source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/navigation/step.component.ts)
- [Storybook source](../../../../projects/design-library/src/lib/navigation/step.stories.ts)

## Integration decisions

- Import the standalone StepComponent from `@arcwell/ui` and add it to the consuming Angular component’s `imports`.
- Use `appearance` for per-instance presentation and `styleTokens` for theme tokens. Preserve the shared light and black/glass themes; use the library stylesheet.
- Use the exact projection selectors below; unmarked content goes only to the default slot when one exists.
- Configure inputs with Angular bindings for booleans, numbers, arrays and objects. Do not turn signal-backed inputs into method calls in consumer templates.
- Consult the linked story before copying a render recipe: its moduleMetadata imports, helper constants, form setup and custom props may be required.

- `appearance`: [Appearance](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-step-appearance--appearance) — Overrides multiple visual properties for this instance.
- `styleTokens`: [StyleTokens](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-step-appearance--style-tokens) — Overrides CSS theme tokens for this instance and its descendants.
- `value`: [Value](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-step-configuration--value) — Sets the selected or displayed value. Here it is set to “preferences”.
- `label`: [Label](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-step-configuration--label) — Customizes the visible label. Here it is set to “Custom label”.
- `description`: [Description](http://127.0.0.1:6006/?path=/story/navigation-step-configuration--description) — Adds supporting context below the main label or heading. Here it is set to “More context, in your own words.”.
